title: 掃描穿隧顯微鏡~Scanning tunneling microscopes
focus: 穿隧電流指數律、壓電掃描、隔振與雜訊預算的原子級量測工程~Tunneling exponential law, piezo scanning, vibration isolation and noise budgets for atomic-scale metrology
summary: 從穿隧電流對間隙的指數依賴出發，理解 STM 為何能看到單一原子，再把壓電管掃描器、探針製作、隔振、電流雜訊、晶格校正與超高真空低溫系統整合成可驗收的原子級量測工程。~Start from the exponential dependence of tunneling current on gap to see why an STM resolves single atoms, then integrate the piezo tube scanner, tip preparation, vibration isolation, current noise, lattice calibration and the ultrahigh-vacuum cryogenic system into an acceptable atomic-scale metrology record.

units.anchor: 探針—樣品穿隧接面~Tip–sample tunneling junction
units.title: 量子穿隧與指數距離靈敏度~Quantum tunneling and exponential distance sensitivity
units.mechanism: 掃描穿隧顯微鏡把一支金屬探針逼近導電樣品到約 0.5 到 1 nm，施加 mV 到 V 等級的偏壓後，電子以量子穿隧穿過真空位障，形成 pA 到 nA 的電流。穿隧機率隨位障寬度指數衰減，衰減常數 κ 由有效功函數決定，典型值約 1 Å⁻¹，因此探針高度每改變 1 Å，電流就變化將近一個數量級。這個指數關係是 STM 垂直解析度達到皮米等級的根本原因，也是整台儀器對振動與漂移極度敏感的原因。~A scanning tunneling microscope brings a metal tip within roughly 0.5 to 1 nm of a conducting sample; with a bias from millivolts to volts, electrons tunnel through the vacuum barrier and produce a current of picoamperes to nanoamperes. The tunneling probability decays exponentially with barrier width, with a decay constant κ set by the effective work function, typically about 1 Å⁻¹, so a 1 Å change in tip height changes the current by nearly an order of magnitude. This exponential law is the root of picometre vertical resolution and of the instrument's extreme sensitivity to vibration and drift.
units.model: 穿隧電流近似 I ∝ V·exp(−2κd)，其中 κ = √(2mφ)/ħ ≈ 0.51·√φ[eV] Å⁻¹。取有效位障 φ = 4 eV，κ ≈ 1.02 Å⁻¹；距離增加 1 Å，電流乘上 exp(−2.04) ≈ 0.13，即降為約 1/7.7；距離僅變 0.1 Å（10 pm），電流仍變化 exp(−0.204) ≈ 0.815，約 18%。~The tunneling current follows I ∝ V·exp(−2κd) with κ = √(2mφ)/ħ ≈ 0.51·√φ[eV] Å⁻¹. For an effective barrier φ = 4 eV, κ ≈ 1.02 Å⁻¹; a 1 Å increase in gap multiplies the current by exp(−2.04) ≈ 0.13, about 1/7.7, and even a 0.1 Å (10 pm) change alters it by exp(−0.204) ≈ 0.815, about 18%.
units.verify: 做 I–z 曲線：關閉回授，讓探針以已知步幅退離 0.5 到 1 Å 並記錄電流，對 ln I 對 z 作線性擬合，斜率的一半即 κ，再換算有效位障 φ = (κ/0.51)² eV；乾淨金屬表面應得到 3 到 5 eV，若遠低於 1 eV 表示探針或表面有吸附物，接面不是真空穿隧。~Record an I–z curve: open the feedback loop, retract the tip in known steps over 0.5 to 1 Å while logging the current, fit ln I against z, and take half the slope as κ, then convert to an effective barrier φ = (κ/0.51)² eV. A clean metal surface should give 3 to 5 eV; values far below 1 eV indicate adsorbates on the tip or surface and a junction that is not a vacuum tunneling gap.
units.failure: 探針撞上表面或沾到污染後，接面變成點接觸或透過吸附分子導電，I–z 曲線斜率變平、影像出現重影或對比反轉；工程後果是整張影像的高度刻度失真，而操作者可能把 κ 偏低誤以為是樣品特性。~After a tip crash or contamination pickup the junction becomes a point contact or conducts through an adsorbed molecule; the I–z slope flattens and images show double tips or inverted contrast. The engineering consequence is a distorted height scale across the whole image, while the operator may misread the low κ as a sample property.
units.misconception: 穿隧電流隨距離線性減小，所以退開 2 倍距離電流只剩一半。~Tunneling current falls linearly with distance, so doubling the gap halves the current.

units.anchor: dI/dV 鎖相訊號~dI/dV lock-in signal
units.title: 穿隧能譜與局域態密度~Tunneling spectroscopy and the local density of states
units.mechanism: 在 Tersoff–Hamann 近似下，低偏壓的穿隧電流正比於探針位置處樣品局域態密度在費米能階附近的積分，因此微分電導 dI/dV 與能量為 eV 的局域態密度成正比。實作上在直流偏壓上疊加 kHz 等級、振幅零點幾 mV 的正弦調變，用鎖相放大器取出一階諧波。能量解析度受到探針費米分佈的熱展寬與調變振幅限制，這是把 STM 冷到液氦溫度的主要動機之一。~In the Tersoff–Hamann picture the low-bias tunneling current is proportional to the sample's local density of states at the tip position integrated near the Fermi level, so the differential conductance dI/dV tracks the local density of states at energy eV. In practice a sinusoidal modulation of a few hundred microvolts at kilohertz frequency is added to the dc bias and a lock-in amplifier extracts the first harmonic. Energy resolution is limited by thermal broadening of the tip's Fermi distribution and by the modulation amplitude, which is a main reason for cooling the STM to liquid-helium temperature.
units.model: 費米分佈導數的半高寬約 3.5·k_B·T。T = 300 K 時 k_B·T = 25.9 meV，熱展寬約 90 meV；T = 77 K 時 k_B·T = 6.6 meV，展寬約 23 meV；T = 4.5 K 時 k_B·T = 0.39 meV，展寬約 1.4 meV。若鎖相調變 0.1 mV rms 另貢獻約 0.25 meV，總解析度 ≈ √(1.4² + 0.25²) ≈ 1.4 meV，足以分辨 Pb 的超導能隙 2Δ ≈ 2.7 meV。~The derivative of the Fermi function has a full width of about 3.5·k_B·T. At 300 K, k_B·T = 25.9 meV and the thermal broadening is about 90 meV; at 77 K, k_B·T = 6.6 meV gives about 23 meV; at 4.5 K, k_B·T = 0.39 meV gives about 1.4 meV. A 0.1 mV rms lock-in modulation adds roughly 0.25 meV, so the total resolution ≈ √(1.4² + 0.25²) ≈ 1.4 meV, enough to resolve the superconducting gap of Pb, 2Δ ≈ 2.7 meV.
units.verify: 以已知能譜特徵校驗：在 Au(111) 上量 dI/dV，表面態起始邊緣應落在約 −0.49 eV（相對費米能階）；在超導 Pb 或 Nb 薄膜上量能隙，用 BCS 態密度與熱展寬捲積擬合，擬合出的有效溫度若明顯高於溫度計讀值，代表有射頻雜訊或調變過大。~Check against known spectral features: measure dI/dV on Au(111), where the surface-state onset should appear near −0.49 eV relative to the Fermi level; on superconducting Pb or Nb films fit the gap with a BCS density of states convolved with thermal broadening. An effective temperature from the fit clearly above the thermometer reading reveals radio-frequency noise or excessive modulation.
units.failure: 探針本身若有非平坦的態密度（例如尖端帶著原子團或氧化物），dI/dV 會疊上探針的結構，被誤判為樣品能譜；典型症狀是更換探針狀態後同一位置的能譜不可重現。~If the tip itself has a structured density of states, for example a cluster or oxide at the apex, its features are superimposed on dI/dV and mistaken for sample spectra; the typical symptom is that spectra at the same location fail to reproduce after a tip change.
units.misconception: STM 影像就是原子位置的直接地形圖，與電子態無關。~An STM image is a direct map of atom positions independent of electronic states.

units.anchor: PZT 壓電管掃描器~PZT piezo tube scanner
units.title: 壓電掃描器的靈敏度、遲滯與潛變~Piezo scanner sensitivity, hysteresis and creep
units.mechanism: 多數 STM 用一支外電極分成四象限的 PZT 壓電管當掃描器：在對向象限施加反相電壓，管子一側伸長一側縮短而彎曲，帶動探針做 x、y 掃描；全部電極共同施加電壓則改變長度做 z 方向控制。壓電陶瓷是鐵電材料，位移對電壓有遲滯，電壓階躍後還會隨時間對數潛變；液氦溫度下 d₃₁ 係數降到室溫的約五分之一，掃描範圍相應縮小，但遲滯與潛變也顯著減弱。~Most STMs scan with a PZT tube whose outer electrode is split into four quadrants: opposite quadrants driven with opposite voltages make one side extend and the other contract, bending the tube to move the tip in x and y, while a common voltage changes the length for z control. Piezoceramics are ferroelectric, so displacement shows hysteresis against voltage and creeps logarithmically in time after a voltage step; at liquid-helium temperature the d₃₁ coefficient drops to roughly one fifth of its room-temperature value, shrinking the scan range but also suppressing hysteresis and creep.
units.model: 壓電管側向偏折 Δx ≈ 2√2·d₃₁·L²·V/(π·D·h)。取 d₃₁ = 173 pm/V、長度 L = 12.7 mm、直徑 D = 6.35 mm、壁厚 h = 0.5 mm、V = 100 V：Δx ≈ 2.83×173×10⁻¹²×(12.7×10⁻³)²×100/(π×6.35×10⁻³×0.5×10⁻³) ≈ 0.79 µm，即約 7.9 nm/V，±100 V 的掃描範圍約 1.6 µm；在 4 K 下 d₃₁ 約降為 35 pm/V，範圍縮到約 0.3 µm。潛變以 Δx(t) = Δx₀[1 + γ·log₁₀(t/0.1 s)] 估計，γ = 0.02 時 100 s 後再漂 6%。~The lateral tube deflection is Δx ≈ 2√2·d₃₁·L²·V/(π·D·h). With d₃₁ = 173 pm/V, length L = 12.7 mm, diameter D = 6.35 mm, wall h = 0.5 mm and V = 100 V: Δx ≈ 2.83×173×10⁻¹²×(12.7×10⁻³)²×100/(π×6.35×10⁻³×0.5×10⁻³) ≈ 0.79 µm, about 7.9 nm/V, so ±100 V scans about 1.6 µm; at 4 K with d₃₁ near 35 pm/V the range shrinks to about 0.3 µm. Creep follows Δx(t) = Δx₀[1 + γ·log₁₀(t/0.1 s)]; with γ = 0.02 the tip drifts a further 6% after 100 s.
units.verify: 用已知週期的標準樣品（HOPG 的 0.246 nm 或 Si(111)-7×7 的 2.69 nm 晶胞）在數個掃描範圍量靈敏度，並比較正向與反向掃描線的位置差得到遲滯量；對 z 軸施加電壓階躍後連續記錄高度 100 s，擬合對數潛變係數 γ，低溫與室溫各做一次。~Measure sensitivity at several scan sizes on a sample of known period (HOPG at 0.246 nm or the 2.69 nm Si(111)-7×7 unit cell), and compare forward and backward scan lines to quantify hysteresis; apply a voltage step on z, record the height for 100 s and fit the logarithmic creep coefficient γ, once at room temperature and once cold.
units.failure: 掃描範圍切換後立刻取像，潛變使影像前幾十條掃描線被拉伸或壓縮，晶格間距在同一張圖內不一致；若用這張圖做校正，所有後續尺寸量測都會系統性偏差。~Imaging immediately after a scan-size change lets creep stretch or compress the first tens of scan lines so that lattice spacing varies within one frame; calibrating from such a frame propagates a systematic error into every later dimensional measurement.
units.misconception: 壓電位移與電壓成嚴格線性，所以電壓除以靈敏度就是真實位置。~Piezo displacement is strictly linear in voltage, so voltage divided by sensitivity is the true position.

units.anchor: 鎢探針與彈簧隔振平台~Tungsten tip and spring isolation stage
units.title: 探針製作、剛性本體與隔振設計~Tip preparation, rigid body and vibration isolation
units.mechanism: 鎢探針通常以 0.25 mm 鎢絲在約 2 M NaOH 中電化學蝕刻而成，巨觀曲率半徑數十 nm，但真正決定解析度的是尖端最末端的單一原子或原子團；進入真空後再以電子束加熱或場發射去除氧化層。隔振採取兩個層次：STM 本體做得極小、極剛，使其最低機械共振在 kHz 以上，讓低頻地板振動只造成探針與樣品的共模運動；整個本體再掛在共振頻率 1 到 2 Hz 的彈簧上並用渦電流阻尼，把地板振動在共振以上以 1/f² 衰減。~Tungsten tips are usually electrochemically etched from 0.25 mm wire in about 2 M NaOH to a macroscopic radius of tens of nanometres, but resolution is decided by the single atom or small cluster at the very apex; in vacuum the oxide is removed by electron-beam heating or field emission. Vibration isolation works on two levels: the STM body is made small and stiff so its lowest mechanical resonance lies above a kilohertz and low-frequency floor motion moves tip and sample together, and the whole body hangs on springs with a 1 to 2 Hz resonance damped by eddy currents, attenuating floor vibration above resonance as 1/f².
units.model: 彈簧級的傳遞率在共振以上近似 T ≈ (f₀/f)²：f₀ = 1.5 Hz、f = 30 Hz 時 T ≈ 0.0025（−52 dB）。若地板在 30 Hz 的振幅為 100 nm，經彈簧級後為 0.25 nm；本體共振 2 kHz 時探針—樣品的相對位移約再乘 (30/2000)² = 2.25×10⁻⁴，得 0.06 pm。對照電流穩定要求 ΔI/I = 2κ·Δd：Δd = 1 pm 時 ΔI/I ≈ 2%，所以 0.06 pm 的殘餘振動是可接受的。~Above resonance the spring stage transmits about T ≈ (f₀/f)²: with f₀ = 1.5 Hz and f = 30 Hz, T ≈ 0.0025 (−52 dB). A 100 nm floor amplitude at 30 Hz becomes 0.25 nm after the spring stage, and a 2 kHz body resonance multiplies the tip–sample relative motion by a further (30/2000)² = 2.25×10⁻⁴, giving 0.06 pm. Against the current-stability requirement ΔI/I = 2κ·Δd, where Δd = 1 pm already gives about 2%, a residual of 0.06 pm is acceptable.
units.verify: 用加速規或地震計量地板與隔振平台的振動頻譜，計算實測傳遞率並與 1/f² 模型比較；在穿隧狀態下記錄 z 訊號的功率譜，尋找與建築機械（約 25 到 50 Hz）或泵浦對應的尖峰，確認殘餘振幅換算後低於 1 pm。探針則以場發射電流穩定性與 HOPG 原子影像驗收。~Measure vibration spectra of the floor and the isolated platform with accelerometers or a seismometer, compute the actual transmissibility and compare with the 1/f² model; while tunneling, record the power spectrum of the z signal and look for peaks matching building machinery (roughly 25 to 50 Hz) or pumps, confirming that the converted residual stays below 1 pm. Accept the tip by field-emission current stability and by atomic imaging on HOPG.
units.failure: 若彈簧級阻尼不足，共振附近的放大反而把 1 到 3 Hz 的地板擺動放大數倍，影像上出現週期性波紋；若本體剛性不足，共振落在幾百 Hz，與泵浦或冷頭的諧波耦合，原子解析度完全消失。~With insufficient damping the spring stage amplifies 1 to 3 Hz floor sway several times near resonance and periodic ripples appear in images; with a soft body whose resonance lies at a few hundred hertz, pump or cold-head harmonics couple in and atomic resolution disappears entirely.
units.misconception: 隔振只要彈簧夠軟就行，本體剛性無關緊要。~Isolation only needs soft springs; body stiffness does not matter.

units.anchor: Si(111)-7×7 標準晶格~Si(111)-7×7 reference lattice
units.title: 橫向與垂直尺度校正與熱漂移~Lateral and vertical scale calibration and thermal drift
units.mechanism: STM 沒有內建的長度基準，所有尺寸都來自壓電靈敏度與回授高度的換算，因此必須用已知晶格校正：橫向用 Si(111)-7×7 的 2.69 nm 晶胞或 HOPG 的 0.246 nm 原子間距，垂直用單原子台階高度，例如 Au(111) 0.235 nm、Cu(111) 0.208 nm、Si(111) 雙層 0.314 nm。熱漂移來自探針、樣品與掃描器之間的溫差與不等的熱膨脹，表現為影像的剪切與拉伸；低溫下漂移可降到每小時數十 pm，室溫下常達每分鐘 nm 等級。~An STM has no built-in length standard; every dimension comes from piezo sensitivity and feedback height conversion, so known lattices must calibrate it: laterally the 2.69 nm Si(111)-7×7 unit cell or the 0.246 nm HOPG atomic spacing, vertically single-atom step heights such as Au(111) at 0.235 nm, Cu(111) at 0.208 nm and the Si(111) bilayer at 0.314 nm. Thermal drift arises from temperature differences and unequal expansion among tip, sample and scanner and appears as shear and stretch in images; cold it can fall to tens of picometres per hour, while at room temperature nanometres per minute are common.
units.model: 若量到 7×7 晶胞為 2.55 nm，橫向修正係數為 2.69/2.55 = 1.055（原靈敏度低估 5.2%）；量到 Au(111) 台階 0.221 nm，則 z 修正係數為 0.235/0.221 = 1.063。漂移影響：256 條線、每線 1 s 的影像需 256 s，若漂移 0.1 nm/min，影像期間累積 0.43 nm，對 50 nm 的視野造成 0.9% 的剪切，對 5 nm 的原子影像則達 8.5%，必須先量漂移速度再補償。~If the 7×7 unit cell measures 2.55 nm the lateral correction factor is 2.69/2.55 = 1.055 (sensitivity underestimated by 5.2%); if an Au(111) step measures 0.221 nm the z factor is 0.235/0.221 = 1.063. Drift impact: a 256-line frame at 1 s per line takes 256 s, and at 0.1 nm/min the accumulated drift is 0.43 nm, a 0.9% shear over a 50 nm field but 8.5% over a 5 nm atomic image, so the drift velocity must be measured and compensated first.
units.verify: 對同一區域連續取三張正反向影像，用互相關求出特徵位移向量，除以時間得到漂移速度並寫進掃描補償；校正後再量一次標準晶格，三個方向的殘差應在 1% 以內，並記錄校正時的溫度與掃描範圍，因為靈敏度隨兩者改變。~Take three consecutive forward and backward frames of one area, cross-correlate features to get the displacement vector, divide by time to obtain the drift velocity and enter it into scan compensation; then re-measure the reference lattice and require residuals within 1% in all three axes, recording the temperature and scan size because sensitivity depends on both.
units.failure: 在室溫校正而在 5 K 使用，靈敏度差了數倍，所有量測尺寸同步縮水；更隱蔽的是 x 與 y 靈敏度不同造成晶格角度失真，六方晶格看起來像菱形，被誤解為表面重構。~Calibrating at room temperature and using the scanner at 5 K leaves a several-fold sensitivity error that shrinks every measured dimension; more insidiously, unequal x and y sensitivities distort lattice angles so that a hexagonal lattice looks rhombic and is misread as a surface reconstruction.
units.misconception: 廠商給的壓電靈敏度在所有溫度與掃描範圍都通用。~The vendor's piezo sensitivity applies at every temperature and scan size.

units.anchor: 1 GΩ 轉阻前置放大器~1 GΩ transimpedance preamplifier
units.title: 電流雜訊預算與等效間隙雜訊~Current-noise budget and equivalent gap noise
units.mechanism: pA 等級的穿隧電流由轉阻放大器轉成電壓，回授電阻通常為 10⁸ 到 10⁹ Ω。雜訊來源有三：回授電阻的 Johnson 熱雜訊、穿隧電流本身的散粒雜訊，以及放大器輸入電壓雜訊透過接面與纜線電容在高頻轉成的電流雜訊；此外還有 50/60 Hz 干擾與 1/f 雜訊。因為電流與間隙是指數關係，任何電流雜訊都可以換算成等效的間隙雜訊，與振動、漂移放在同一張預算表比較。~The picoampere tunneling current is converted to a voltage by a transimpedance amplifier with a feedback resistor of 10⁸ to 10⁹ Ω. Three noise sources matter: Johnson noise of the feedback resistor, shot noise of the tunneling current itself, and the amplifier's input voltage noise converted to current noise at high frequency through junction and cable capacitance, plus mains interference and 1/f noise. Because current and gap are exponentially linked, any current noise converts to an equivalent gap noise that can sit in one budget table beside vibration and drift.
units.model: 取 R_f = 1 GΩ、T = 300 K、頻寬 B = 1 kHz：Johnson 電流雜訊 √(4k_BT·B/R_f) = √(1.66×10⁻²⁰×10³/10⁹) ≈ 0.13 pA rms；設定電流 I = 100 pA 的散粒雜訊 √(2eI·B) = √(2×1.6×10⁻¹⁹×10⁻¹⁰×10³) ≈ 0.18 pA rms；合成 √(0.13² + 0.18²) ≈ 0.22 pA，相對 0.22%。等效間隙雜訊 Δd = (ΔI/I)/(2κ) = 0.0022/(2×1.02 Å⁻¹) ≈ 1.1×10⁻³ Å ≈ 0.11 pm。~With R_f = 1 GΩ, T = 300 K and bandwidth B = 1 kHz: Johnson current noise √(4k_BT·B/R_f) = √(1.66×10⁻²⁰×10³/10⁹) ≈ 0.13 pA rms; shot noise at a 100 pA set point √(2eI·B) = √(2×1.6×10⁻¹⁹×10⁻¹⁰×10³) ≈ 0.18 pA rms; combined √(0.13² + 0.18²) ≈ 0.22 pA, or 0.22% of the set point. The equivalent gap noise is Δd = (ΔI/I)/(2κ) = 0.0022/(2×1.02 Å⁻¹) ≈ 1.1×10⁻³ Å ≈ 0.11 pm.
units.verify: 把探針退到不穿隧的位置量前置放大器輸出的雜訊頻譜，確認底噪與 Johnson 估計相符且無 50/60 Hz 尖峰；再進入穿隧狀態在不同設定電流（10、100、1000 pA）記錄電流雜訊，驗證散粒雜訊按 √I 增加；最後把等效間隙雜訊與振動量測結果一起列表。~Retract the tip out of tunneling and record the preamplifier output noise spectrum, confirming the floor matches the Johnson estimate without mains peaks; then tunnel at several set points (10, 100 and 1000 pA) and verify that shot noise grows as √I; finally tabulate the equivalent gap noise alongside the vibration measurements.
units.failure: 前置放大器接地迴路或纜線過長使 50 Hz 與射頻雜訊進入電流訊號，回授迴路把它當成高度變化去補償，影像出現平行條紋且能譜被人為展寬；提高回授增益只會讓條紋更明顯。~A ground loop or over-long cable lets mains and radio-frequency pickup enter the current signal; the feedback loop treats it as a height change and compensates, producing parallel stripes in images and artificially broadened spectra, and raising the feedback gain only makes the stripes stronger.
units.misconception: 把回授電阻加大十倍，所有雜訊都會降低十倍。~Making the feedback resistor ten times larger lowers all noise ten times.

units.anchor: UHV 製備腔與液氦槽~UHV preparation chamber and LHe bath
units.title: 超高真空製備、低溫槽與系統整合~UHV preparation, cryostat bath and system integration
units.mechanism: 原子級乾淨的表面只能在超高真空維持：在 10⁻¹⁰ mbar 下殘氣分子形成一層單分子層需要數小時，足夠完成製備與成像。製備腔配備離子濺射、加熱台、蒸鍍源與 LEED，樣品以傳送桿在不破真空下送入 STM 腔。低溫 STM 把本體懸掛在液氦槽內，外層再以液氮槽隔熱，兩層輻射屏遮住 300 K 熱輻射；槽的持冷時間由熱負載與液氦蒸發潛熱決定，商用系統超過 65 h。整合的關鍵是讓製備、傳送、冷卻、隔振與訊號線在同一真空與熱設計下互不妨礙。~Atomically clean surfaces survive only in ultrahigh vacuum: at 10⁻¹⁰ mbar residual gas needs hours to build one monolayer, long enough for preparation and imaging. The preparation chamber carries ion sputtering, a heating stage, evaporators and LEED, and a transfer arm moves samples into the STM chamber without breaking vacuum. A low-temperature STM hangs the body inside a liquid-helium bath surrounded by a liquid-nitrogen bath, with two radiation shields blocking 300 K radiation; the hold time is set by heat load and the latent heat of helium, and commercial systems exceed 65 h. Integration means that preparation, transfer, cooling, isolation and signal lines coexist within one vacuum and thermal design without interfering.
units.model: 單分子層形成時間 t ≈ 1/(s·Φ·σ)：以黏附係數 s = 1 估算，10⁻⁶ mbar 約 1 到 3 s，10⁻¹⁰ mbar 則約 3 到 4 h。液氦消耗：潛熱約 2.6 kJ/L，若總熱負載 50 mW，每小時蒸發 0.18 kJ ÷ 2.6 kJ/L ≈ 0.07 L，4 L 槽可撐約 58 h；熱負載升到 80 mW 時只剩 36 h。~The monolayer formation time t ≈ 1/(s·Φ·σ): with sticking coefficient s = 1 it is about 1 to 3 s at 10⁻⁶ mbar and about 3 to 4 h at 10⁻¹⁰ mbar. Helium consumption: the latent heat is about 2.6 kJ/L, so a 50 mW total heat load evaporates 0.18 kJ per hour divided by 2.6 kJ/L ≈ 0.07 L/h and a 4 L bath lasts about 58 h; at 80 mW the hold time drops to 36 h.
units.verify: 用殘氣分析儀確認 H₂、CO、H₂O 分壓並記錄總壓；製備後以 LEED 看到清晰的 7×7 或 (√3×√3) 繞射點再進 STM；冷卻後以探針附近的溫度計與超導能隙擬合溫度互相印證，並記錄液氦液位對時間的曲線，從斜率反推實際熱負載與設計值比較。~Confirm H₂, CO and H₂O partial pressures with a residual-gas analyser and log the total pressure; after preparation require sharp 7×7 or (√3×√3) LEED spots before transferring into the STM; once cold, cross-check the thermometer near the tip against the temperature from a superconducting-gap fit, and record the helium level versus time so the slope gives the real heat load for comparison with design.
units.failure: 輻射屏的視窗或訊號線的熱錨固不良會把數十 mW 的額外熱負載帶進液氦槽，持冷時間減半、本體溫度升高，熱漂移與熱展寬同時惡化；真空側的小洩漏則讓表面在數十分鐘內被 CO 覆蓋，影像出現隨時間增加的吸附物。~Poorly anchored signal lines or open shield windows add tens of milliwatts to the helium bath, halving the hold time and raising the body temperature so drift and thermal broadening degrade together; a small vacuum leak instead covers the surface with CO within tens of minutes and adsorbates accumulate in successive images.
units.misconception: 真空夠好就不需要再冷卻，低溫只是為了減少雜訊。~A good enough vacuum removes the need for cooling, which only reduces noise.

units.anchor: 驗收測試矩陣~Acceptance test matrix
units.title: 系統驗收、基準樣品與工程交接~System acceptance, reference samples and engineering handoff
units.mechanism: 驗收不是看單一張漂亮的原子影像，而是一組可重複的量化指標：標準樣品的晶格尺寸與台階高度、穿隧狀態下的 z 雜訊頻譜、漂移速度、能譜解析度以及持冷時間，每一項都對應前面各單元的模型。交接文件要記錄校正係數隨溫度與掃描範圍的表、隔振傳遞率量測、前置放大器雜訊底、探針製備參數與樣品製備配方的來源，讓下一位使用者能重建同樣的性能。~Acceptance is not one pretty atomic image but a repeatable set of quantified indicators: lattice dimensions and step heights on reference samples, the z-noise spectrum while tunneling, drift velocity, spectroscopic resolution and hold time, each tied to a model from the earlier units. The handoff record lists calibration factors versus temperature and scan size, the measured isolation transmissibility, the preamplifier noise floor, tip-preparation parameters and the provenance of sample recipes, so the next user can rebuild the same performance.
units.model: 能譜驗收以 Pb 超導能隙為例：Δ ≈ 1.35 meV，相干峰間距 2Δ ≈ 2.7 meV。在 4.5 K 熱展寬 1.4 meV 下，BCS 擬合應回復 Δ 在 1.3 到 1.4 meV、有效溫度 4.5 ± 0.5 K；若擬合溫度為 8 K（展寬 2.4 meV），表示有 √(2.4² − 1.4²) ≈ 2.0 meV 的額外展寬來自射頻或調變。地形驗收：HOPG 原子起伏約 20 pm，z 雜訊 0.13 pm rms 給出信噪比約 150。~Spectroscopic acceptance using the Pb superconducting gap: Δ ≈ 1.35 meV, coherence peaks 2Δ ≈ 2.7 meV apart. With 1.4 meV thermal broadening at 4.5 K a BCS fit should return Δ between 1.3 and 1.4 meV and an effective temperature of 4.5 ± 0.5 K; a fitted 8 K (2.4 meV broadening) instead implies √(2.4² − 1.4²) ≈ 2.0 meV of extra broadening from radio-frequency pickup or modulation. Topographic acceptance: the HOPG atomic corrugation is about 20 pm, and 0.13 pm rms z noise gives a signal-to-noise ratio near 150.
units.verify: 依序執行：HOPG 與 Si(111)-7×7 成像並比對晶格；Au(111) 台階高度；停止掃描、在穿隧狀態記錄 10 分鐘 z 訊號得到雜訊與漂移；Pb 能隙能譜擬合；72 小時液氦液位紀錄。所有結果與模型預測並列，偏差超過 20% 者需找出原因後才能簽核。~Run in order: image HOPG and Si(111)-7×7 and compare lattices; measure Au(111) step heights; with scanning stopped, record 10 minutes of z signal while tunneling to obtain noise and drift; fit the Pb gap spectrum; log the helium level for 72 hours. Place every result beside its model prediction, and investigate any deviation above 20% before signing off.
units.failure: 只用一張經過濾波的原子影像驗收，會把高雜訊與漂移藏在影像處理裡；幾個月後使用者在小掃描範圍做能譜時才發現解析度達不到規格，而原始驗收資料已無法重建。~Accepting on a single filtered atomic image hides high noise and drift inside image processing; months later a user doing spectroscopy at small scan size finds the resolution out of specification, and the original acceptance data cannot be reconstructed.
units.misconception: 看到原子就代表系統全部合格。~Seeing atoms means the whole system passes.

example: 雜訊預算練習：假設 κ = 1.02 Å⁻¹、前置放大器 R_f = 1 GΩ 在 300 K、頻寬 1 kHz、設定電流 100 pA。Johnson 雜訊 0.13 pA、散粒雜訊 0.18 pA，合成 0.22 pA rms，相對 0.22%，等效間隙雜訊 0.0022/(2×1.02) ≈ 1.1×10⁻³ Å = 0.11 pm；加上隔振後殘餘振動 0.06 pm，總 z 雜訊 √(0.11² + 0.06²) ≈ 0.13 pm，對 HOPG 約 20 pm 的原子起伏信噪比約 150。若把設定電流降到 10 pA，散粒雜訊降為 0.057 pA，但 Johnson 雜訊仍為 0.13 pA，合成 0.14 pA 相對 1.4%，等效間隙雜訊升到 0.0014/2.04 ≈ 0.7 pm，信噪比掉到約 28，說明低電流成像必須同時縮小頻寬或改用更大的回授電阻。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實機規格。~Noise-budget exercise: assume κ = 1.02 Å⁻¹, a 1 GΩ preamplifier at 300 K, 1 kHz bandwidth and a 100 pA set point. Johnson noise is 0.13 pA and shot noise 0.18 pA, combining to 0.22 pA rms, or 0.22%, which converts to an equivalent gap noise of 0.0022/(2×1.02) ≈ 1.1×10⁻³ Å = 0.11 pm; adding the 0.06 pm residual vibration after isolation gives a total z noise of √(0.11² + 0.06²) ≈ 0.13 pm, a signal-to-noise ratio near 150 against the 20 pm atomic corrugation of HOPG. Lowering the set point to 10 pA reduces shot noise to 0.057 pA while Johnson noise stays at 0.13 pA, so the combined 0.14 pA is now 1.4% and the equivalent gap noise rises to 0.0014/2.04 ≈ 0.7 pm, dropping the signal-to-noise ratio to about 28; low-current imaging therefore needs a narrower bandwidth or a larger feedback resistor. Values are teaching assumptions, not any instrument's specification.
history: 1981 年 Gerd Binnig 與 Heinrich Rohrer 在 IBM 蘇黎世研究實驗室建成第一台掃描穿隧顯微鏡，1983 年拍到 Si(111)-7×7 重構的真實空間影像，兩人因此獲得 1986 年諾貝爾物理獎；1990 年 IBM 的 Don Eigler 用低溫 STM 搬動單一 Xe 原子，證明探針也能操控原子。1990 年代起超高真空低溫 STM 商品化，液氦槽式系統成為表面物理與穿隧能譜的標準平台。本課只重建公開的物理與工程邏輯。~In 1981 Gerd Binnig and Heinrich Rohrer built the first scanning tunneling microscope at IBM Research in Zurich, imaged the Si(111)-7×7 reconstruction in real space in 1983 and shared the 1986 Nobel Prize in Physics; in 1990 Don Eigler at IBM used a low-temperature STM to position single Xe atoms, showing that the tip can also manipulate matter. Ultrahigh-vacuum low-temperature STMs became commercial products from the 1990s, and helium-bath systems are now the standard platform for surface physics and tunneling spectroscopy. This course reconstructs only public physics and engineering logic.
